leadText:
The unnamed sportscaster (Japanese: Announcer) is a character of the day who appeared in Getting a Jump on the Competition!. He was one of the hosts for the Pokémon Sled Jump Games on Mount Lanakila, the other being the Pokémon Sled Jump master.

During the games, he introduced all of the contestants, and later Cerah during her exhibition jump. At the end, he announced that the winner was Hala and .
